title: Keep encoded DATA and one-time switching in the startup contract
statement: The acquired unreviewed boot candidate holds storage payload dynamics off while complete onsite controller resets run for a finite interval, with encoded DATA and logical-independent arbitrary controller/bath input. Its proposed backward positive-test bound is p_boot=exp(C eta T)[u_boot+(1-u_boot)exp(-kappa T)], followed by bounded-footprint frame labels and a separate small-support/common-span tail argument. It is an explicit one-time mode switch, not autonomous self-start, encoded-DATA generation or a reviewed upgrade of the whole storage theorem.
